alsoChecked: The observations flagged two unlabeled buttons crowded 7px apart on #mbr/build — minor and tied to no criterion.
The start card meta reads 19 KPIs where the illustrative drawing shows 14, and the Published list shows only July 2026 — data differences, not layout mismatches, so not filed as gaps.

Every KPI in the seeded draft is Manual/Carried because the pull returned no fresh values, which is why no Auto tag, Collect control or amber Refresh-all box appears in the shots; those states are covered by the passing suite.
The project's own test suite ran green: 597 tests across 100 files passed (exit 0).
summary: Captain, the rebuilt MBR flow is substantially there: the Reviews entry screen, the collection screen, and the redesigned builder all render with the right eyebrow/title/subtitle, the amber draft banner, the 'Insights added — 16 of 19' completion bar, five-silhouette status selects with a distinct red X for off-track, purple Carried pills, cohort 'change vs last MBR' deltas, and manual inline cells — and your own suite of 597 tests passes green, covering the lock gate, autosave, re-pull, dialogs, and Preview/View. The one real blemish is cosmetic but visible: three primary action buttons — Pull data & start, Continue to builder, and Lock month — render with their icons blown up past the button edges and their labels wrapped onto 2–3 lines, where your mockup draws each compact on one line. Everything works; I'd ship with that button-icon fix as the named known issue.
